sampling_algorithm.test_ids: Original N001-N300, exact strings/order and source metadata preserved
sampling_algorithm.normalize_for_leakage_only: Unicode NFKC, remove all whitespace, casefold; never edit actual model sentence strings
exclude_from_training_and_development: All 248 corporations represented by the fixed 300 test sentences
All exact and normalized fixed-test sentence strings, even in other companies
All normalized strings from the previous 2700-sentence experiment
sampling_algorithm.metadata: Require exact corp_code/year/rcept_no match in the pinned current SOURCE_PLAN; use real corp_name, no inferred source
sampling_algorithm.global_duplicate_representative: For each normalized string, select minimum deterministic SHA-256(seed|source identity plus source CSV row); do not choose a representative by model performance or favorable label
sampling_algorithm.company_partition: SHA-256(seed|corp_code) integer modulo 5 equals 0 for dev; other corporations for train
sampling_algorithm.stratification: Original saved rule class only for sampling: train 500 and dev 100 per class; exact rank is deterministic SHA-256(seed|source identity plus source CSV row)
sampling_algorithm.teacher_replay: Apply the unchanged frozen classifier to the selected real original strings and correct original company/year; preserve both saved and current rule labels, never repair a label
sampling_algorithm.label_changes: No resampling on current-label changes; record actual class counts and stop if a training/development class is absent

weight_scope: Original validation posthoc reconstructed globalSHA256 deduplicated sentence frame, not full25millionraw corpus
training_reference: current unchanged Python-rule pseudo-labels; no human test labels for training/development/selection
evaluation_reference: Same final 300 human labels for rules and all eight neural runs
sampling_reproduction_scope: Fixed selected sentences are supplied. Rebuilding the entire historical 175542-sentence source pool is not required to replay this fixed benchmark and is not claimed by this supplement.
